column1: # mapping_set_description: "The work vocabulary to Armis asset search (POST /v3/assets/_search). Object ids are response paths as documented in Armis's developer guide (Extracting device information). Armis sees the host an agent runs on, not the agent's identity, so the actor mappings are close, not exact."

column5: Registered agents carry the registry's tag; an unregistered actor lacks it.
